messages:
maria_csm: Weekly account health check for Solara Inc — focus: hosted API commit vs observed run-rate. Commit = $75,000/mo. 7-day extrapolated run-rate = $210,000/mo (2.8x). Primary driver: /v1/embeddings-bulk. 7d tokens = 18.7M, embeddings requests +280% vs baseline, p95 latency 320ms, error rate 1.8% with a sharp spike to 4.5% at ~03:40 UTC. Link: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/solara/health :chart_with_upwards_trend:

usage-bot: :rotating_light: Anomaly detected — account=Solara route=/v1/embeddings-bulk percent_increase=280% baseline_window=7d generated_ticket=CS-5901

devin_billing: ouch. is this a sustained batch or ad-hoc explorer traffic? i can provision a temporary $25k buffer to avoid immediate overage, but want engineering to confirm mitigation plan first. :money_with_wings:

li_yang: saw the traces — traffic originates from a single API key with ~48 concurrent workers hitting the bulk endpoint. looks like their migration worker hammered full-document embeddings instead of incremental. suggests: 1) enable per-key concurrency cap (default 10), 2) apply token-based soft-throttles, 3) reduce sampling on huge docs.

natalie_runtime: agree. we can push a runtime rule to: route high-volume keys to embed-compact (quantized), enable adaptive sampling for docs >50k tokens, and apply 10s backoff for retry storms. quick API to set a rule: curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/controls/routing -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"account":"solara","route":"/v1/embeddings-bulk","fallback_model":"embed-compact","concurrency_cap":10,"sampling_threshold":50000}'

devin_billing: willing to apply buffer if we can gate it to this incident only. Maria — ok to approve $25k emergency buffer for this billing period?

maria_csm: approve $25k buffer for this month. Devin, please attach a note in billing portal referencing CS-5901. Li/Natalie — prioritize a temporary rule rollout (canary -> full) and add an alert suppression window to avoid repeated noise. I'll flag renewal status: risk = moderate-high (usage unpredictability + cost increase).

li_yang: rolling a canary now to enforce per-key concurrency=10 and fall back to embed-compact for keys exceeding daily token threshold 120k. canary id: canary-5901 pushed at 1756601500. monitoring traces for error reduction.

usage-bot: update: post-canary metrics at 1756601700 — embeddings-bulk increase reduced to +22%, p95 latency down to 180ms, error rate back to 0.4%. ongoing monitor next_check=1h

natalie_runtime: patch ready for full rollout pending verification of no regressions on small-batch customers. also drafting a short enablement note for Solara ops on batching best practices and SDK snippet to use incremental embeddings.

maria_csm: thanks. action items: NATALIE add SDK snippet and schedule enablement session with Solara ops (tomorrow 11am PT); LI verify full rollout and post before/after token table; DEVIN confirm buffer attached and update commit forecast in renewal deck. I'll follow up Friday 9am PT with updated renewal recommendation. :white_check_mark:
